The integration of these pathways implies that Leflunomide may influence Ahr activity through Mexiletine, potentially altering gene expression in liver cells. This mechanism is supported by the presence of an organic aromatic compound as the lowest common ancestor, suggesting a biochemical pathway involving aromatic compounds. The evidence is consistent with a direct interaction between Leflunomide and Ahr via Mexiletine, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The relationship is biologically plausible, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the causal link.
